description:
Files:
- lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex
- lib/zaq/channels/bridge_supervisor.ex
- lib/zaq/channels/supervisor.ex
- lib/zaq/channels/connector_runtime.ex
- reviewed upstream worker fix or documented local runtime owner

Functional specifications:
Recognize linked_device listener mode. Start shared Amarula infrastructure under current static supervisor and accounts under supported runtime APIs. Stop actual account connection or safely adopt and rebind its sink. Handle crashes/kill, partial startup rollback and all bootstrap/restart paths; terminate callback alone is insufficient. Disable A without affecting B. Keep credentials on disable; forgetting device is a separate explicit operation. Do not leave final fixes as edits in deps. Load paired state from the custom credential-backed storage adapter; connection status requires successful authentication, not merely presence of stored state.
Architecture refinement: JidoChatBridge delegates to provider-neutral lifecycle contract. Provider implementation owns Amarula start/stop/adoption/rebind. Common lifecycle must not depend on Amarula-specific process or QR payload shapes.
User requirement: disable channel through existing channel lifecycle, preserving other profiles. Restart must clear runtime/in-memory state and restore session from persisted storage without new QR. Include full application/BEAM process restart validation rather than relying only on a worker restart; external persistent store retained.

Tests before implementation:
- Start A/B then stop/restart A while B works
- No already_running or stale sink after worker crash/kill
- Partial startup cleanup
- Idempotent stop
- Application restart and duplicate start
- Exercise shared contract with a minimal fake second provider; keep WhatsApp-specific expectations in provider contract tests

Branches validated:
- start
- stop
- restart
- crash
- kill
- partial failure
- bootstrap
- two accounts

Documentation:
- docs/services/channels.md
- runtime ownership module docs

Action reuse assessment:
Extend JidoChatBridge, BridgeSupervisor and ConnectorRuntime start/stop boundaries; local process ownership, no agent Action. Input resolved connector, output actual lifecycle outcome/error. Reuse explicit runtime Events and preserve credentials. Inspect and reuse existing device-connection behavior before adding shared modules; document any missing contract as a prerequisite. No duplicate provider-specific credential store or pairing framework.

Validation:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle; tests before implementation, focused checks per issue, final gate before approval. No live account connection or send without scoped authorization.

Mocking:
External Amarula transport only; use real internal boundaries and isolated DB/process/storage fixtures; inject config and clock without global mutation.

Policy:
Recheck module responsibilities, docs/services/channels.md, Action reuse, system-config and testing guidance before coding. BO calls use explicit NodeRouter Events; nil actor never grants permission.
